PwaInstall.title: Install Tolo
PwaInstall.description: Open Tolo from your home screen or app list. An internet connection is required to use it.
PwaInstall.nativeIntro: Press Install below, then choose Install in your browser’s confirmation window.
PwaInstall.dismissed: Installation was canceled. You can try again from your browser’s menu.
PwaInstall.error: The confirmation window could not be opened. Follow the steps below to install from your browser.
PwaInstall.accepted: Your installation request was accepted. Once it finishes, open Tolo from your home screen or app list.

iosSteps.first: Open this page in Safari and tap Share (a square with an upward arrow). If you cannot see it, open the page menu in the address bar and choose Share.
iosSteps.second: Scroll down in the menu and choose Add to Home Screen. If Open as Web App appears, turn it on.
iosSteps.third: Tap Add. Open Tolo using its new icon on your home screen.

androidSteps.first: Open this page in Chrome and tap the ︙ menu at the top right.
androidSteps.second: Choose Install and create shortcut → Install. Depending on your version, choose Install app or Add to home screen instead, then follow the instructions on the screen.
androidSteps.third: Open Tolo using its icon on your home screen or app list. If the menu option is missing, reload this page in a regular tab and try again.

desktopSteps.first: Open this page in Chrome or Edge.
desktopSteps.second: Click the install icon at the right of the address bar. If you cannot see it, in Chrome choose ︙ → Cast, save, and share → Install page as app. In Edge, choose … → More tools (if shown) → Apps → Install this site as an app.
desktopSteps.third: Choose Install in the confirmation window. Open Tolo from your app list.

macSteps.first: Open this page in Safari (macOS Sonoma or later).
macSteps.second: Choose File → Add to Dock in the menu bar, then click Add.
macSteps.third: Open Tolo using its new icon in the Dock.

PwaInstall.otherIntro: Steps vary by browser and device. Choose the instructions for your device. If an option is missing, open this page in one of the supported browsers below.
PwaInstall.insecure: Installation requires HTTPS. Open the public site using its HTTPS URL.
